title: Demo field guide
intro: Every demo surface in one place: what it shows, what to click, and a link straight to the live route. Cards are defined in data/cards.json — edit that file, rebuild, done.
credentialsNote: Sign-in credentials are not published on this page. Ask the demo owner who sent you here.

cards.title: Example card
cards.what: Replace this card in data/cards.json with your real demo surfaces. Each card is: title, optional badge, the route it lives at, a short what-it-shows paragraph, and optional numbered steps.
steps: Sign in (credentials from your demo owner).
Click the demo's primary action and watch the governed flow run.
Change one setting and run it again to see the gate respond.
